entries.en: Added Claude in Chrome (Beta) feature that works with the Chrome extension (https://claude.ai/chrome) to let you control your browser directly from Claude Code
entries.zh: 在 Chrome (Beta) 中添加了 Claude 功能，可与 Chrome 扩展 (https://claude.ai/chrome) 配合使用，让您直接从 Claude 代码控制浏览器

entries.en: Added scannable QR code to mobile app tip for quick app downloads
entries.zh: 在移动应用程序提示中添加了可扫描的二维码，以便快速下载应用程序

entries.en: Added loading indicator when resuming conversations for better feedback
entries.zh: 恢复对话时添加加载指示器以获得更好的反馈

entries.en: Improved @ mention file suggestion speed (~3× faster in git repositories)
entries.zh: 改进 @ 提及文件建议的速度（在 git 仓库中约快 3 倍）

entries.en: Improved file suggestion performance in repos with `.ignore` or `.rgignore` files
entries.zh: 改进含 `.ignore` 或 `.rgignore` 文件的仓库中的文件建议性能

entries.en: Improved settings validation errors to be more prominent
entries.zh: 改进设置验证报错，使其更醒目

entries.en: Changed thinking toggle from Tab to Alt+T to avoid accidental triggers
entries.zh: 将思维切换从 Tab 更改为 Alt+T，以避免意外触发

entries.en: Fixed `/context` command not respecting custom system prompts in non-interactive mode
entries.zh: 修复了非交互模式下`/context`命令不遵守自定义系统提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed order of consecutive Ctrl+K lines when pasting with Ctrl+Y
entries.zh: 修复了使用 Ctrl+Y 粘贴时连续 Ctrl+K 行的顺序
